entries.reason: the method takes an MTLStages, a type that arrived with the SDK of iOS 26; the backports of this package build against the SDK of 16.4, where the type does not exist to be written, and inventing a stand-in for it would change the signature the application compiled against (facts/Metal/Blits.md)
entries.effect: the selector is not there: respondsToSelector: answers NO and a call through a compile time reference crashes; a stage barrier would have been a no-op on this device anyway, because the port has one queue and issues each command as it is encoded, which facts/Metal/Blits.md records
entries.source: SDK 26.2, Metal, MTLCommandEncoder.h; and the SDK of 16.4 this package builds against, which has no MTLStages
